layout_concept: Four-page A4 landscape sequence with one dominant image per page and shifting asymmetry: p1 cover with hero image offset right and title column left; p2 tall portrait image left with concept text and a small square image right; p3 the plan as large evidence plate with a narrow text column; p4 the panoramic image full-width as a closing statement with a quiet caption. Serif (Georgia, italic for headings) against Korean-capable sans (Malgun) for body; a single deep-teal accent used only on short hairlines and folios; muted grey for secondary text.
principles: spend boldness in one place: the image scale changes each page, type stays quiet
one accent colour, used only as short rules and folios
images locked at native aspect, never cropped
no text that duplicates what the drawing shows
generic_defaults_checked: cream+serif+terracotta: replaced by white paper with deep teal accent
identical cards: pages use different compositions per image aspect
all-caps eyebrow labels: sentence-case labels only
numbered markers without a real sequence: none used except page folios
